name: shokai-dashboard
description: Development commands for the ShokAI web application

scripts.predev: npm --prefix packages/contracts run build && node scripts/sync-explainability-assets.mjs
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/contracts run build && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:metadata && npm run test:import && npm --prefix packages/contracts test && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/contracts run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
